feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home, DOJ says it approved the warrant
entry.summary: The Justice Department says the search is part of an "ongoing federal investigation", while Omar calls it "an attempt to target political enemies"

entry.title: India's opposition parties march to top court as protests over voter lists escalate
entry.summary: Opposition parties say revisions to the list of eligible voters favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party. Authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll.

entry.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments
entry.summary: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.

entry.title: Here's what to know if you're unsure about your measles immunity status
entry.summary: Vaccination is the best way to protect yourself against measles. For most adults, one shot of the MMR is considered enough protection. But there are certain situations that call for a second dose.

entry.title: Mahershala Ali is still hungry as an actor: 'Let's fail on camera until we find it'
entry.summary: Ali plays a devout Muslim family man, who also happens to be an assassin in Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother. After decades in the business and two Oscars, he says he has less fear as an actor.

entry.title: Fontaines D.C.'s decadent, dystopian vision of our time
entry.summary: "I just want to make people really feel things about the world they live in," Grian Chatten says of Dopamine Chamber, which he describes as the band's attempt to map the tensions of our moment.

entry.title: 2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
entry.summary: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

entry.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to an 'energy ceasefire'
entry.summary: President Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire," but he offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV said he would undergo surgery after doctors found a "localized nodule" in his lung.

entry.title: Hurricane Simon pounds resorts and vulnerable towns along Mexico's Pacific coast
entry.summary: Hurricane Simon pounded Mexico's Pacific coast as a Category 3 storm on Sunday, as its most powerful winds and rain slammed people living between the Sierra Madre and the ocean.
